title: Synthesis, computational studies, and biological evaluation of novel cyanoacrylamides as potential anticancer agents.
authors: Soliman, Marwa H; Barakat, Karim; Abdelhamid, Ismail A; Mohamed, Mona H; Elzayat, Emad M; Abdelwahab, Abdelhady A; Attia, Yasmin M; Ragheb, Mohamed A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并评估新型氰基丙烯酰胺类抗癌化合物的细胞毒性与凋亡机制，虽含DNA结合亲和力测定和分子对接，但核心为药物化学与抗癌活性，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法上仅常规对接，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: A novel series of cyanoacrylamides based on thiazole was synthesized and characterized by different physicochemical and multispectral investigations. The new compounds have been assessed for their cytotoxic potential against several human cancer cell lines (HCT-116, MCF-7, HEp-2, and WI-38). Compound 5g, incorporating 4-(piperidin-1-yl)phenyl moiety, was selected as it emerged to achieve the potent cytotoxic effect against HCT-116 and MCF-7 cell lines, with IC(50) values of 32 and 49 microM, respectively. In addition, the selectivity index was calculated to be > 3.1 against the HCT-116 cell line, where it exhibits a low cytotoxic effect against the WI-38 cell line. Compound 5g also has the capability to induce both early and late apoptosis of HCT-116 cells. Moreover, flow cytometric analysis of HCT-116 cells treated with compound 5g showed a pronounced increase in cells in the S and G2/M phases with a consequent reduction of cells in the G(0)/G1 phase, indicating that compound 5g induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. In addition, the results were confirmed by increased caspase-3 activity, downregulation of Bcl-2, CDK1, and CDK2 expression, and upregulation of Bax expression, as evidenced by qRT-PCR and ELISA analyses. Additionally, 5g exhibited a favorable DNA binding affinity as determined through UV-Vis measurements with a K(b) value of 1.39 x 10(4) M(-1). The drug-like features of 5g were evaluated, and its ADMET properties were predicted. Moreover, a molecular docking study of 5g was performed with different proteins, Bcl2, CDK1, and CDK2, which generates a docking score value range from -4.78 to -7.06 kcal mol(-1).
abstract_zh: 合成并表征了一系列基于噻唑的新型氰基丙烯酰胺类化合物，通过不同的物理化学及多光谱研究手段进行了分析。这些新化合物针对多种人类癌细胞系（HCT-116、MCF-7、HEp-2 和 WI-38）评估了其细胞毒性潜力。化合物 5g，含有 4-(哌啶-1-基)苯基部分，因其对 HCT-116 和 MCF-7 细胞系表现出强效细胞毒性作用而被选中，其 IC(50) 值分别为 32 和 49 微摩尔。此外，针对 HCT-116 细胞系的选择性指数计算为 > 3.1，其中该化合物对 WI-38 细胞系表现出低细胞毒性。化合物 5g 还能诱导 HCT-116 细胞的早期和晚期凋亡。此外，用化合物 5g 处理的 HCT-116 细胞的流式细胞术分析显示，S 和 G2/M 期的细胞显著增加，而 G(0)/G1 期的细胞相应减少，表明化合物 5g 诱导细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。另外，通过 qRT-PCR 和 ELISA 分析证实，结果表现为 caspase-3 活性增加、Bcl-2、CDK1 和 CDK2 表达下调，以及 Bax 表达上调。此外，通过 UV-Vis 测量确定，5g 表现出良好的 DNA 结合亲和力，其 K(b) 值为 1.39 x 10(4) M(-1)。评估了 5g 的药物样特性，并预测了其 ADMET 性质。此外，对 5g 与不同蛋白质（Bcl2、CDK1 和 CDK2）进行了分子对接研究，产生的对接分数值范围为 -4.78 至 -7.06 kcal mol(-1)。
